messages:
Jordan: Quick proposal — tweak the weekly triage to reduce churn and make owner handoffs cleaner. Move it to Tue 09:00 PT, 20 minutes, focused agenda.

Proposed agenda (20m):
```
1) 2m quick metrics (errors / SLO blips)
2) 8m bug backlog quick-sort (triage into hotfix / backlog / follow-up)
3) 8m hotfix lane + owner assignment
4) 2m blockers & follow-ups
```

Rotation idea: week A = infra, week B = runtime, week C = product for hotfix lead. Can folks ack or suggest alternate times? Also thinking we add a simple label "regression" to tickets we want immediate attention.

Priya: Heads-up I have a recurring 09:00 on Tue — Tue 09 won't work for me. Wed 10:00 PT is open though.

Sam: @Jordan I actually prefer mornings but earlier than 9 helps APAC overlap. Tue 08:30 PT, 20m would be better for me. 20m sounds good either way.

Maya: Shorter is good. If we compress to 20m please add a quick regression flag check (1 person scans for recent regressions). I can take that role if needed. Also can we add a saved filter for "regression" in the backlog view?

Devon: I can swap my Wed morning meeting. If we do Tue 09 I'll pick up hotfix lane owner for the next two weeks. @infra-bot can you update the rota/calendar once we decide?

infra-bot: calendar-bot: Creating event draft: "Weekly Triage (proposed)" Tue 09:00 PT, 20m. Draft link: https://calendar.example/ev/abc123 — will finalize after thumbs-up.

Jordan: Quick poll — react with :thumbsup: for Tue 09, :thumbsdown: to keep current Wed slot, :pray: if you want to propose a different time. Also, please add the "regression" label to any ticket you want flagged before the meeting.

Priya: :thumbsdown: (sorry, recurring can't move)

Sam: :thumbsup: (I can do Tue 09 if others prefer, but 08:30 would be slightly better)

Maya: :thumbsup: — I'll own regression checks and created a saved filter: "label:regression AND status:open"

Devon: :thumbsup: will take hotfix lane for 2 weeks starting next Tue.

Jordan: Looks like majority for Tue 09. Final decision: move weekly triage to Tue 09:00 PT, 20 minutes. Action items: Devon = hotfix owner (2 weeks), Maya = regression check owner + saved filter, Priya = will stay on backlog doc maintenance (evening async) since your recurring blocks mornings, I'll update the meeting description and add the concise agenda. infra-bot — please finalize event and add the rota note.

infra-bot: calendar-bot: Event finalized: Weekly Triage — Tue 09:00 PT, 20m. Rota notes: weekA infra, weekB runtime, weekC product. Link: https://calendar.example/ev/abc123

Jordan: Thanks everyone — please add :raised_hand: in the event if you plan to be owner that week. Closing thread."
